_comment: This is the extension manifest file - it defines your extension's metadata and requirements
_comment_id: REQUIRED: Unique identifier for your extension (use kebab-case)
_comment_name: REQUIRED: Display name shown in the Extensions UI
name: Demo Extension
_comment_description: REQUIRED: Brief description of what your extension does (max 500 characters)
description: A demonstration extension showcasing all features of the Ticaga extension system. Use this as a template for building your own extensions.
_comment_author: REQUIRED: Your name or organization name
author: Ticaga Team
_comment_homepage: OPTIONAL: URL to extension's homepage or documentation
_comment_icon: OPTIONAL: Heroicon name for UI display (see https://heroicons.com)

requires._comment: These versions are checked during installation

_comment_capabilities: OPTIONAL: List of capabilities/features your extension provides
